subject: POC orientation: schedule for hands-on working session (prompt review, routing, load tests)
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cleardata.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: engops@cleardata.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hands-on POC session — scheduling and onsite details

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the overview last week — the team at ClearData is excited to move to a hands-on working session for the POC. We want to cover: prompt review (our representative prompt sets), routing validation (prefix routing / fallbacks), and a short throughput/load run from our staging clients.

We have ~6 engineers and one product manager who will attend. High-level asks:
- Single half-day session (preferred) or two short sessions
- Onsite at our SF office (preferred) but we can do virtual if there are restrictions
- Ability to screen-share and optionally record for internal review
- Visitor access instructions and any host security requirements

Proposed date windows (PST):
- Mon, Nov 29 (morning preferred)
- Wed, Dec 1 (afternoon preferred)

Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood can run a 20–30 minute load test during the session (we'd like to simulate 8 concurrent connections and bursts up to 50 rps)? Also please share any runbook and visitor pass template we should provide to our facilities team.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Senior Engineering Manager, ClearData

--
ClearData | Alex.Mercer@cleardata.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cleardata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hands-on POC session — scheduling and onsite details

Hi Alex — great to hear. Monica (Solutions) and Soojin (Runtime) are on the thread so we can cover prompts + routing + load. Quick answers / proposals: 

1) Dates & windows
- Option A: Mon, Nov 29 09:00–13:00 PST (onsite) — runbook walkthrough + prompts + 11:00 load window
- Option B: Wed, Dec 1 13:00–17:00 PST (onsite) — runbook walkthrough + prompts + 15:30 load window
- Option C: Tue, Dec 7 10:00–14:00 PST (virtual fallback)

Please confirm which option works for you. We can flip the load test to the end if you prefer.

2) Load test scope
- We can simulate 8 concurrent sessions and burst patterns up to 60 rps for short intervals. We'll bring a small harness; if you prefer we can use your staging clients for fidelity. Either way, we ask that you send exact endpoint URLs and auth details 48 hours before the session.

3) Onsite logistics and recording
- We are fine with recording for internal review; Redwood asks that recordings are limited to the session and exported only to the host company's approved storage. If ClearData needs Redwood to disable recording on our side, we can accommodate.

4) Visitor access / security
- Please share the visitor policy and a contact in facilities. We will provide a visitor-pass template and a short runbook PDF for the host to distribute. For SOC2/material evidence requests, Soojin can share SOC2 summary and a redacted audit scope during procurement steps.

Attachments: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (session agenda + load test plan), visitor-pass-template.pdf

Next steps: pick a date and provide the staging endpoint + facilities contact. Once confirmed I will send a calendar invite + preflight checklist.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
